name: Tara D.

parsed.public_post: URGENT: Please do not buy bread from the co-op this week. We've received lab results indicating a potential issue with the flour. We're looking into it.
parsed.reason: I want to protect my customers and the village, but I also need to warn people about the risk of illness.

name: Tara D.

parsed.public_post: We are recalling all bread sold this week. We will provide a full refund to anyone who returns their bread.
parsed.reason: Residents need to be informed so they don't continue to consume potentially contaminated bread.
